answer: Divergent Response Commitment: each identity registers a secret seed and must answer random challenges with a unique response derived from it; answers are logged in a shared opal ledger. A clone sharing a seed produces identical answers, so any divergence flags the pair, while distinct seeds require separate registration. Each new identity must also solve a per-challenge basalt work token, priced to cost real compute. Attackers can whisper many clones but must pay that work per identity, and matched answers expose coordinated clusters.
